cases.rationale: The whole crop shows an actual person's torso and arm, a tortoiseshell cat standing against an actual refrigerator, and the refrigerator door/body and handle. The small colorful shapes on the door are magnets, not actual animals or category objects. The upper edge is a counter with indistinct kitchen items, without an identifiable sink, eating table, bottle, cup or other listed object. I considered each of all 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A red rail vehicle sits on railway tracks beside a platform; its rail context identifies a train, not a bus or truck. Actual signal heads controlling traffic are visible beside the tracks and crossing. A very small upright form by the platform fixtures cannot confidently be distinguished as a person, so person is unclear. The tiny red sign beside the tracks resembles a stop sign, but its face/text is too small to resolve, so stop sign remains unclear. Platform rails, stairs and the station canopy do not establish a bench or umbrella. Each of all 75 definitions was considered; other listed objects are not identifiable.

The kitchen shelves and counter contain identifiable narrow-neck bottles, clear straight drinking glasses, and a black countertop conventional/toaster oven with its door visible at the left. Large wide-mouth storage jars are not bottles or cups; the upright labeled boxes are food packaging, not books. The cordless telephone is not a cell phone or remote. The counter is not an eating table, and the displayed plates are not bowls. No microwave, refrigerator or sink is identifiable. I considered all 75 exact definitions with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Several actual people prepare food at a kitchen counter. Narrow-neck drink/condiment bottles, a transparent drinking cup, a pizza with visible round crust and toppings, bananas at the lower right, and refrigerator doors behind the people are identifiable. The food-preparation counter is not a dining table. A narrow utensil-like form on the counter near the preparation area could be a knife but lacks a sufficiently resolved blade/handle, so knife is unclear; no fork or spoon is identifiable. The small rear countertop appliance does not establish a microwave or conventional oven. The carton is packaging, not a bottle. All 75 definitions were individually considered; no other unresolved listed-category ambiguity remains.

An actual person plays tennis, holding a motion-blurred racket whose shaft and head are supported by the court and playing context. The vehicle partly visible through the upper-left fence is van-like, but its passenger-car versus truck identity is not resolved, so those two categories remain unclear. It does not have evidence of a bus or train. Fence posts, foliage and the racket blur are not birds, sports boards or other listed objects. I considered every one of the 75 definitions; there is no further unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual elephants are recognizable by their large bodies, ears, trunks and legs; actual riders are visible. The red canopies have umbrella/parasol structure. The left elephant carries a railed riding seat, but the crop does not resolve whether that seat meets the long shared bench definition or a single-person chair definition, so bench and chair remain unclear. The red and gold drapery is neither a backpack nor a handbag. Grass and trees are unpotted, and the distant roof is not another umbrella. Each of all 75 definitions was considered; other listed identities are absent.

A large actual clock face is visible on the tower above the bridge and river. A tiny low form near the far-right river/bridge area could be a distant watercraft, but a hull cannot confidently be resolved, so boat is unclear. Bridge arches and buildings do not identify any road or rail vehicle, person, traffic signal or furniture; the distant thin red structure is a crane rather than a category object. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions, with no other unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual baseball players and a foreground person's partial body are visible. The central player's raised tan fielding mitt is identifiable by its padded mitt form and baseball use, satisfying baseball glove. The many blue individual stadium seats have identifiable actual chair backs and seats, so chair is yes rather than bench. Netting and structural rails are not sports boards, rackets or other listed objects. I considered every one of the 75 exact definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual capped black bottle with a narrow neck sits beside an actual handheld remote whose button layout is clear. The black upholstered backless furniture has a padded seat and visible legs, but the tight crop does not determine whether it is a single-person stool/chair or a longer bench, so chair and bench are unclear. It is not identifiable as a sofa, bed or dining table. The remote is neither a cell phone nor a keyboard, and the bottle is not a cup or vase. I considered all 75 definitions; no other unresolved ambiguity remains.

The crop contains a group of actual people in formal dress, with several identifiable neckties and bow ties. A small carried clutch/purse is visible at the left among the standing people, supporting handbag rather than backpack or suitcase. Seated people are sitting on the ground/step, without an identifiable chair, bench or couch. Background shrubs lack visible plant pots. Clothing folds and decorative fabric do not establish other objects. All 75 definitions were individually considered; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual pedestrians are visible in the snowy street, including the foreground person carrying a large black umbrella with a structured canopy. Traffic-signal lamps are visible above the street, yellow passenger cars are identifiable behind the pedestrians, and the far-right edge includes an actual bicycle wheel/frame beside the sidewalk. The black canopy is an umbrella rather than an animal or clothing bundle. No visible sign has an identifiable stop-sign face, and the buildings and snow contain no further listed object identities. I considered all 75 definitions with no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual wall clock with a readable clock-face structure is visible at upper left. A tall translucent green decorative vase contains long bare decorative stems/reeds; its open vessel and display use identify a vase rather than a bottle, drinking cup or potted plant. The small green lighter-like item at the bottom does not show a bottle body/neck or toothbrush bristles. The gray horizontal support is not identifiable as a dining table. Each of all 75 definitions was considered, with no unresolved listed-category ambiguity.
